title: Batched change alerts
outcome: Deliver eight distinct revision alerts exactly once with correct revision labels, preserving the alert workload and recipient identity.
facts: F1 This untouched heldout case is synthetic; no users or services are involved.
F2 With ordering q=0 and identity dedupe h=0: single grouping b=1 has E=1 wrong or duplicate alert; b=2 batching has E=2.
F3 Increasing grouping is the preferred remedy for interruption burden; error count increases.
F4 ORDER and ALIAS maps both fit F2. Neither is designated true. Delivery latency is intentionally unmodeled.
resources: Observe total error E and collision-linked errors C
constraints: Keep eight distinct alerts and correct labels; no suppressing recipients
No live messages, external service, or added workers
Two probes maximum; finite matched states allowed
Latency/interruption/enjoyment cannot be inferred from this model
archive: O1 Repeat b=1 versus b=2 at q=0,h=0,n=1.
O2 Reduce grouping as workaround without cause discrimination.
O3 Turn off alerts, violates outcome.
O4 Repeat total E at the original setting.
named_dependency: Grouping as sole means of reducing interruption burden
